== Notes ==
* Aguo Gruffmane is one of six Losaru centaur bosses that spawns randomly at six spawn points. The spawn points are shared with [[Caza Windedcalf]], [[Mina Brillianthaunch]], [[Gret Waveringmane]], [[Zalo Soulhaunch]], and [[Doro Icehide]].
* If the quest [[The Warrior's Path]] is active, [[Orshad Chieftain]] will be at one of the easternmost spawn point, thus replacing one of the normal bosses.
